package.name: nxt_sensors_ros
package.description: The nxt_sensors_ros package provides the bindings between the NXT world and the ROS world on the robot. This package will create a ROS topic for each NXT sensor, and publish the sensor's data on this topic. The nxt_sensors_ros bindings talk directly to the NXT brick over USB.
package.author: Rodolphe Matias de Sousa
